entities.summary: Alla Ivanivna Lyshafay is an international football defender currently playing for Zorky Krasnogorsk in the Russian league. She previously played for Lehenda Chernihiv, Gömrükçü Baku and Zvezda Perm, with whom she played the 2008-09 UEFA Women's Cup final.
